title: sesleria dura
intro: Sesleria dura, commonly known as Balkan hair grass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sesleria dura include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of several diseases. The bioactive constituents of Sesleria dura include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
